notes: Live Activities ki sending aur mazboot kar di gayi hai — ab app background mein khud behtareen route par shift ho jati hai, is liye message atakne ka masla ab khud handle ho jata hai. Koi nayi setting ya tabdeeli nazar nahi ayegi; sab kuch pehle ki tarah hi chalega, bas sending zyada bharosay ke qabil ho gayi hai.
releaseNotes: Flashy v2.26: Live Activities sending ka background nizam mazboot kiya gaya hai. Ab agar ek route se message na ja sakay to app khud aglay route par shift ho jati hai aur jo route kaam kar jaye usi ko is session mein pehle rakhti hai — user ko kuch karna nahi parta, koi nayi screen, setting ya popup nahi hai. Rozana raat ko background mein routes ki taza fehrist khud update hoti rehti hai taake sending na rukay. Group Setup ki maujooda (v2.25 wali) proxy setting bilkul pehle ki tarah hai — aap ki apni proxy hamesha sab se pehle istemal hoti hai. Verification: node harness 30/30, asal Chromium probe 8/8 (Group Setup mein sirf purani proxy setting, koi naya proxy interface kahin nahi); APK badging versionCode 36 / 2.26, signer purana wala; APK ke andar ki tamam files nayi build se byte-identical.
